dict.string: Pocketd reads your calendar to tell you what's next, and adds events when you ask. Your events stay on this iPhone, and other devices can't read them.
Pocketd reads your sleep, activity and heart data to compare today with your usual. It stays on this iPhone, and other devices can't read it.
Pocketd does not write to Health. This permission is requested only because iOS requires the description to be present whenever an app links HealthKit.
When you turn on Use from your laptop, Pocketd answers your other devices over your Wi-Fi. Nothing leaves your local network.
Pocketd listens only while the microphone is on, to hear your question. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
Pocketd reads your reminders to tell you what's due, and adds or ticks them off when you ask. They stay on this iPhone, and other devices can't read them.
Pocketd turns your voice into text on this iPhone so you can ask by speaking. Audio is processed on the device and never uploaded.
